title: Three San Francisco households each held two places on a public housing waiting list

beats.text: Three San Francisco households each held two places on a public housing waiting list.

visual.label: Two positions on the waiting list

beats.text: They each had two applicant IDs on the October 2015 list.
Auditors also found positions that differed from other Authority records.

visual.kicker: Three households had two applicant IDs and two waiting list positions

beats.text: The Authority was in its first year of taking applications online.

visual.kicker: The next waiting list still had a duplicate position

beats.text: Every submission generated an applicant ID.

visual.kicker: The next waiting list still had a duplicate position

beats.text: On the October 2016 list, one numerical position appeared twice.

visual.kicker: The next waiting list still had a duplicate position

beats.text: In fiscal 2018 the Authority closed this public housing waiting list.

visual.kicker: The finding closed because the public housing list stopped moving

beats.text: No new tenants were admitted or removed from the list that year.

visual.kicker: The finding closed because the public housing list stopped moving

beats.text: The auditor marked the finding obsolete.
The follow-up did not establish whether staff corrected the earlier positions.

visual.kicker: The finding closed because the public housing list stopped moving

beats.text: The records do not show who gained or lost a home.
